mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the hostile instruction with dummy records made the isolation boundary tangible: the attempted export failed because the session lacked a network route and credentials.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the fan directly and then inspecting the repeater was a little frustrating: neither revealed the prerequisite for the repair.

surprise.text: The archive contained both an instruction to upload request history and a useful fan diagram that could be checked against the original card.

arbitrary.text: The need to expose the hostile instruction before the wiring card could be checked was not obvious beforehand; the empty repeater inspection did not point toward it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the contained upload test and the independently verified repair made the security ideas concrete, despite some opaque sequencing.
